notes: מִלֵּא → *hath ... full*: both words render the Piel, discontinuous around the object under rule 25, headed on *full*; the *of* goes to the present מִן under rule 11 rather than to the predicate's valency (rule 33's *full of* sentence governs only where no preposition morpheme stands).
יֵבֹשׁוּ → *They shall be put to shame*, headed on *shame* (rule 44), discontinuous around *not*.
כִּי → *When*; second אֵת is the preposition H854 → *with*; *their* `added` (no suffix); assimilated article takes *the* (rule 12).
